text:
maria: Hey — accepted the org invite but I can’t push to my feature branch. GitHub shows me as a Member, but when I try to push I get: "remote: error: insufficient permission: protected branch". Who do I ping to get team membership/roles fixed?

devon: Welcome! Quick check — did you accept SSO? If SSO isn’t accepted GitHub can show you in the org but not map you to teams.

maria: I did accept SSO via Okta (it shows me in the org). I also added my SSH key. Screenshot: "You don't have permission to push to this repository".

kira: pinging @scott-platform — can you help with team sync? @maria what repo is this for?

maria: It's redwood/frontend-app. Trying to push branch feature/e2e-fix. Need to push to trigger CI.

onboard-bot: New-hire checklist update: maria (email: maria@redwood.ai) — SSO accepted, SSH key uploaded. Notified platform team for team-sync.

scott: Hey all — looks like your invite created a Member account but the team auto-assign didn’t run for the alias you used. I can re-run the sync and add you to the frontend-devs team temporarily. Do you need push (write) now or just PR access?

maria: Need push now to run a quick fix.

scott: Okay I gave you write on redwood/frontend-app and re-ran team-sync for your email. Also relaxed branch-protection for your PR to allow the push. Try again:
```
# create branch & push
git checkout -b feature/e2e-fix
# make change
git add .
git commit -m "fix: flaky e2e hook"
# push to origin
 git push origin feature/e2e-fix
```

devon: FYI to check mapped teams locally you can run (requires gh auth):
```
gh api /user/teams --jq '.[] | .name'
```
or open your GitHub profile -> Organizations -> Teams.

kira: We keep a short troubleshooting checklist in the onboarding doc: /docs/onboarding/github-perms (it mentions email alias issues & SSO acceptance). If this recurs we should update the invite flow.

maria: Tried push, looks good — PR created and CI kicked off. Thank you! :tada:

scott: Great — leaving a note in ticket #1234 to harden the team-sync for future invites with alternate email aliases. Closing here once you confirm everything works.

maria: Confirmed, all good. Closing.
